Pay for Metro

There are several ways to pay to ride Metrorail and Metrobus. The easiest is Smart Trip, which you can add to your phone or buy as a plastic card.

Fares

Metrorail

Metrorail fares are distance based. Peak fares range from $2.25 to $6.75. Off-peak trips are capped at $2.50. You must tap when you enter and again when you exit.

Metrobus

Metrobus is a flat $2.25 ($1.10 reduced). Express routes cost $4.80. Bus drivers cannot make change.

Riding with children

Up to two children under age five ride free with a paying customer.
